name: Chalet Fritz
beschreibung:
Located in the world-renowned resort of St. Anton am Arlberg, Chalet Fritz welcomes guests with stylish elegance and traditional alpine character. Expansive living spaces and premium finishes ensure an exceptional stay.

Legendary Ski Arlberg lifts and slopes alongside spectacular summer hiking routes are within close reach, guaranteeing year-round mountain enjoyment.
kurzbeschreibung: Chalet Fritz in St. Anton am Arlberg combines premium chalet comfort with immediate access to the cradle of alpine skiing.
